INSERT INTO services
             (id, package_id, runtime_install_id, extension_id, instance_name, state, autostart,
              port, bind_addr, data_dir, config_overrides_json)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'stopped', ?, ?, COALESCE(?, '127.0.0.1'), ?, ?)
         ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
